observations.conclusion: VC008 teaches evidence at pack/save/free/load/new-instance boundaries; PHY006 teaches independent absolute units, axis dimensions and surface gap; SEM005 teaches source identity versus node/runtime addresses and upper-strand labels. Shared fixture and some diagnostic overlap are explicit and do not collapse the three courses into an inventory.

Owners are assigned to intended descendants; the original tree is freed, saved PackedScene bytes are loaded with cache ignored, a new instance is observed after two physics frames. Course counts distinguish 36 crossing parents, 72 meshes/bodies/shapes and two shared resources per kind. The 36 scripted rays are not human selections or rendered visibility.

5 mm pitch = .005 m; 2 mm full thickness = .002 m; thickness/pitch=.4; w3-f0 X=.015 m; last grid coordinate=.025 m. Centre heights +/- .0015 m give upper bottom .0005 m, lower top -.0005 m and gap .001 m. The proposed 10 mm assessment pitch gives X=.030 m and ratio=.2. These are nominal declared box values; native comparisons use EPSILON=1e-7 and retained floats are representations, not physical measurement.

The scale control fails independent_world_metres and additional gates; the one-field collider crossing_id control fails identity and aggregate gates while geometry and upper-strand gates pass; restarted parity fails semantic_admission before project creation. The controller is fixed to one source fixture. It records supplied hashes; callers must compare pinned provenance, and digest metadata is not authenticity or semantic truth.

Five criteria per task yield 15 total. Tasks deliberately allow source inspection and overlap with taught examples; outcomes remain null. A hypothetical successful response would not by itself demonstrate unaided transfer, participant performance or causal educational benefit. The proposed changed-pitch task distinguishes adapter fixed-fixture rejection from impossible geometry.

Courses and evidence preserve pending subject, fluent-language, learner and public HTML reviews. One native saved-scene fixture supplies no cloth mechanics, browser/rendering, IX export, ComfyUI/Blender integration, product release or general DSL result. The Windows resolved-launcher correction is described as local; Linux/WSL/macOS and universal reliability are unassessed.
